categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Every idea belongs to a category, and its reviewers decide what happens next. Categories without reviewers are handled by administrators.
categories.name: Name
categories.descriptionHelp: Shown on the idea form to help people pick a category.
categories.ssoGroupHelp: Whoever is in this group at the SSO provider becomes a reviewer of this category at each login, and stops being one after leaving it. Reviewers chosen by hand stay.
categories.noReviewers: No reviewers: administrators review ideas in this category.
categories.stalledDeadlinesHelp: Days without reviewer action before the idea counts as stalled. Empty uses the installation default.

stalled.help: Past its deadline with no reviewer action. Only reviewers and administrators see this mark.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: How the company ideas are doing.

dashboard.decided_other: {{count}} decided ideas (approved, in progress, done, declined or duplicate)
dashboard.noneUndecided: No ideas waiting for a decision.

branding.title: Visual identity
branding.sub: Your company's name, color and images in the SIM, on the login page and in e-mails.
branding.name: Installation name

kindHelp.logoLight: Shown at the top of the SIM and of e-mails (in e-mails, only PNG, JPG or GIF up to 300 KB). Without a logo, the name is shown.
kindHelp.logoDark: Used in the dark theme. Without it, the light logo is used.

statuses.title: Status appearance
statuses.sub: Rename, recolor and describe the Statuses. Their rules do not change. Approved and In progress can be turned off, and ideas skip to the next one; without Draft, every new idea is published right away and existing drafts stay.
statuses.label: Name
statuses.descriptionHelp: Shown as a hint when hovering the Status.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Record of sensitive actions by administrators and the system. It cannot be changed.

actions.authorship.revealed: Revealed the author of an idea
actions.attachment.infected: Had an attachment blocked by the antivirus

ideas.title: Title
ideas.titleHelp: Sum up the idea in one sentence.
ideas.justificationHelp: Recorded in the history, visible to everyone.

fields.title: Form fields
fields.subtitle: Fields people fill in when proposing an idea, besides title and category.
fields.label: Label

likes.likeHelp: Liking shows you also want this idea to happen.
likes.ownIdea: You can't like your own idea.
likes.frozen: Likes are frozen in this status.

comments.title: Discussion
comments.reasonHelp: Everyone will see that the comment was hidden, by whom and why.
comments.hiddenTextVisible: Only you and moderators can see this text.
comments.mentionHelp: Use @ to mention someone; they will be notified.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.newCommentsPreference: Tell me about new comments on ideas I follow

types.reply: {{actor}} replied to your comment on idea #{{number}}
types.stalled: Idea #{{number}} is stalled ({{status}}) and waiting for review
types.stalled_escalated: Idea #{{number}} is still stalled ({{status}}) and needs an administrator

follow.help: Followers get notified about status changes and new comments.

similar.title: Similar ideas already exist
similar.help: How about supporting one of them with a like or adding to it with a comment? If yours is different, you can still publish it.
similar.archivedHint: This idea was archived. Comment on it to ask for it to be reopened.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Product choices for the installation.
settings.hiddenAuthorshipEnable: Let Authors hide their name on an idea
settings.hiddenAuthorshipHelp: Off by default. When on, the Author can appear as "Anonymous collaborator" on the idea and in their comments there. Administrators can identify the Author, and each identification is recorded in the audit log. Turning it off does not reveal ideas that are already hidden.
settings.stalledHelp: Days without reviewer action before an idea counts as stalled, and days after the reviewers are told before the administrators are. Each category can have its own deadlines on the Categories screen.

authorship.hide: Hide my name on this idea
authorship.hideHelp: Colleagues and reviewers will see "Anonymous collaborator". Administrators can identify you, and that is recorded in the audit log.
authorship.youAreHidden: Your name is hidden on this idea. Only administrators can identify you.
authorship.hiddenNotice: The Author of this idea chose to hide their name.
authorship.revealWarning: The identification is recorded in the audit log, with your name.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Set through the server environment variables; this only shows their state. Secrets never appear.
integrations.ssoOff: Off. Set SIM_SSO_MODE to use OIDC or OAuth2.
integrations.smtpHelp: Set SMTP_URL to send notifications by e-mail.
integrations.redisHelp: Needed for e-mail, stalled ideas, automatic deactivation, semantic search and chat channels.
integrations.semanticOff: Off. Set SIM_EMBEDDINGS_URL and SIM_EMBEDDINGS_MODEL (OpenAI, Ollama or another compatible service) to find similar ideas by meaning.
integrations.testOk: Connection ok: the service returned {{dimensions}}-dimension vectors.
integrations.storageHelp: Attachments and identity images. Chosen by SIM_STORAGE (disk on the /data volume, or an S3-compatible bucket).
integrations.webhooksOff: Off. Set SIM_WEBHOOK_SLACK_URL, SIM_WEBHOOK_TEAMS_URL or SIM_WEBHOOK_GOOGLE_CHAT_URL to tell a channel about ideas.
integrations.antivirusOff: Off. Set SIM_CLAMAV_URL (e.g. tcp://clamav:3310) to check every attachment before storing it.
integrations.antivirusOn: Every attachment is checked before it is stored. While the antivirus is down, uploads are refused.

tags.title: Tags
tags.subtitle: Tags group ideas across categories (e.g. Cost, Security). The author picks them on creation and while the idea is open; afterwards, reviewers and administrators do.
tags.name: Name
tags.deleteWarning: It is removed from every idea.
